"no safe guard with zero everything" — that means the peak is null (some cells unreachable) or the guards don't cover. With zero drift and zero jitter: H = (U[a][b]+U[b][a])*5e5 which is NOT zero unless the calibration is exact. Hmm, right: H = the worst residual + jitter. With jitter 0, H = (U[a][b]+U[b][a])*5e5 which is generally positive (the uncertainty in the bias difference). So the peak = max(H over hops) which can exceed g*1e9.

So "zero everything" isn't achievable unless the measurements pin the biases exactly (U[a][b] = -U[b][a]).
